qualification.details: District Programme Manager: Minimum bachelor degree (BNYS) from a recognized university with working experience in organizations working in public health. Exposure in social sector schemes/Mission of Government at national, state, and district level and knowledge of computers including MS Office, MS Word, MS Power Point, MS Excel would be desirable. Preference will be given to persons having PG qualification in AYUSH Stream and experience of working in the Health sector including AYUSH. Yoga and Naturopathy Therapeutic Assistant: Diploma in Nursing Therapist course (for Certificates Issued by Government of Tamil Nadu Only).

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DHS Kancheepuram Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://kancheepuram.nic.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 11-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: DHS Kancheepuram Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for District Programme Manager and 1 for Yoga and Naturopathy Therapeutic Assistant.

content_sections.heading: DHS Kancheepuram Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: District Programme Manager: Minimum bachelor degree (BNYS) from a recognized university with working experience in organizations working in public health. Exposure in social sector schemes/Mission of Government at national, state, and district level and knowledge of computers including MS Office, MS Word, MS Power Point, MS Excel would be desirable. Preference will be given to persons having PG qualification in AYUSH Stream and experience of working in the Health sector including AYUSH. Yoga and Naturopathy Therapeutic Assistant: Diploma in Nursing Therapist course (for Certificates Issued by Government of Tamil Nadu Only).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DHS Kancheepuram Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://kancheepuram.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 11-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DHS Kancheepuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the DHS Kancheepuram Recruitment 2026 is 11th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the District Programme Manager post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the District Programme Manager post in the District Health Society Kancheepuram recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Yoga and Naturopathy Therapeutic Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Nursing Therapist course, specifically for certificates issued by the Government of Tamil Nadu, to be eligible for the Yoga and Naturopathy Therapeutic Assistant position.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided information, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the DHS Kancheepuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the DHS Kancheepuram Recruitment 2026 will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the District Programme Manager position?
faq.answer: The District Programme Manager position offers a monthly salary of Rs. 42,000.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the DHS Kancheepuram Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website for DHS Kancheepuram?
faq.answer: The official website for the District Health Society Kancheepuram is https://kancheepuram.nic.in. Candidates can visit this site for more information and to download the application form.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age relaxations mentioned for the reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age limits or age relaxations for any category. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for detailed information.

faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates along with the filled application form.
